group_windows_by_app.label: Group windows by app
group_windows_by_app.description: General — Choose what Tabber shows and how selection behaves. Show windows from the same app as one switcher item.

enter_grouped_window_selection.label: Enter grouped window selection
enter_grouped_window_selection.description: Let the group key open the selected app's individual windows.

restrict_to_current_monitor.label: Restrict to current monitor
restrict_to_current_monitor.description: Only include windows on the output where Tabber was triggered.

require_pointer_movement_for_hover_selec.label: Require pointer movement for hover selection
require_pointer_movement_for_hover_selec.description: Avoid selecting a card until the pointer moves across the overlay.

cycle_selection_while_holding_tab.label: Cycle while holding Tab
cycle_selection_while_holding_tab.description: Continue cycling after the initial key press while the modifier is held.

stop_continuous_cycle_at_edge.label: Stop continuous cycling at the edge
stop_continuous_cycle_at_edge.description: When enabled, repeated cycling stops at the first or last item instead of wrapping around.

dim_opacity.label: Dim opacity
dim_opacity.description: Appearance — Configure the overlay surface, card layout, and title presentation. Opacity of the background scrim.

container_width.label: Container minimum width
container_width.description: Minimum width in logical pixels; zero keeps automatic sizing.

header_show.label: Show header
header_show.description: Show the title and window count above the cards.

veil_enabled.label: Enable Veil integration
veil_enabled.description: Integrations — Connect Tabber to related plugins and control how their entries appear. Include windows managed by the whereareiam/veil plugin.
